description: This file defines the PageActions class, a Drupal plugin for rendering a top bar item called 'Page Actions' in the navigation module. It manages local tasks, filters featured actions, and builds a render array for the top bar component.

classes.name: PageActions
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class that provides a 'Page Actions' top bar item, managing local tasks and featured actions for the navigation top bar.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the plugin with dependencies like NavigationRenderer and RouteMatchInterface.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the plugin with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the render array for the top bar item, including local tasks and featured actions.

methods.name: getFeaturedPageActions
methods.description: Determines and returns the featured local task based on the current route and available page actions.
